data.name: Yseline
data.gender_notes: Yseline is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Eliana, derived from El (God) and Yah (God's name). Yseline means 'God's gracious gift of a savior.'. The name Yseline carries the meaning “Divine Savior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Yseline usually hope their child will grow to embody divine savior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing devotion to God and His saving grace.
data.etymology: Yseline belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Savior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yseline total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: יסלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יסלין נגזר מהמילה העברית 'יסל' שפירושה 'אלוהים הוא השומר שלי' או 'אלוהים ישמור עליי'. השם מופיע בשורש העברי 'ישלח' שפירושו 'להשלח' או 'להנחות', ויכול להיות קשור לנושא ההשגחה והשמירה האלוהית.

in_greek.name: Υσελίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Υσελίνη πιθανόν να προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις που σχετίζονται με το Θεό και τη φύλαξη. Η ετυμολογία μπορεί να συνδέεται με την προστασία και τη φροντίδα του Θεού, όπως και στην περίπτωση άλλων ονομάτων που έχουν σχέση με τη θεία παρέμβαση.

in_latin.name: Yseline
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Yseline originem habet in voce Latina quae significat 'Deus est custos meus' seu 'Deus meus protector'. Nomen hoc in traditione Christiana potest referri ad protectionem et custodiam divina, quae est communis thematis in onomastico Christiana.

in_english.name: Yseline
in_english.meaning: God is my protector or God will protect
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yseline is believed to derive from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying 'God is my protector' or 'God will protect'. It embodies the theme of divine protection and care, common in Christian onomastics. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to express trust in God's guardianship. The name carries spiritual significance, suggesting a close relationship between the individual and God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yseline carries a rich cultural heritage with its Hebrew origin. In the Christian community, it signifies a deep connection to the Old Testament and the Jewish roots of the faith. It is also a reminder of the importance of God's grace and divine intervention in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Yseline is a powerful name rooted in God's strength and His saving grace. It inspires a deep sense of faith, trust, and reliance on God for protection, guidance, and salvation. The name Yseline is a constant reminder that God is always with us, and He showers us with His grace and mercy, making us His gracious gift and savior.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yseline may symbolize the gentle, flowing grace of the Isle of the Blessed Virgin Mary, whose name in French is "Ile de Sainte Marie," with its tranquil waters reflecting the divine presence in one's soul. This name could serve as a reminder to navigate life's waters with faith and trust, always seeking to mirror the love and compassion of the Mother of God.

historical_references.reference: The name Yseline has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yseline remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Yseline from New York, United States embodies the meaning of Yseline - "Divine Savior". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
